title: [SOA]: Bugbash for releases 28.x - Contact unable to find due to Qasim map to Megan, different names
summary: Sales Order Agent now correctly maps unknown senders to alternative contacts and routes replies to the mapped contact's email address while preserving thread context and original recipients.
key_points: Contact lookup resolves sender mappings stored in SOA Task Contact Override
E-Mail 2 field on Contact table stores alternate email addresses for persistent mappings
Reply routing respects contact mappings and addresses replies to the mapped contact's primary email
Contact List exposes OnBeforeFindRecord event handled only during SOA sessions
Agent instructions updated to accept mapped contacts without requiring user confirmation
